menu.guest:
Welcome 👋
Sign in to your account, or create a new one — all of it right here in the chat.

action.loginWithOtp: Sign in with a one-time code
action.addWithOtp: A code to that account's number

common.cancelled: Cancelled — nothing was saved. Pick something below whenever you are ready.
common.unknown: I did not understand that. Here is what I can do:
common.pickOne: Please choose one of the options above.
common.tryAgain: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
common.expired: That conversation sat idle too long, so I let it go — nothing was saved. Start again below; it only takes a moment.
common.backGone: There is nothing before this. Here is where you can start from:

login.askPhone: Share your number with the button below, or type it (09xxxxxxxxx).
login.askIdentifier: Send your username or phone number.
login.askPassword: Send your password. It is deleted from this chat the moment it arrives.
login.wrongCode: That code is not right. Try again, or ask for a new one.
login.askChatContact: Tap below to sign in with this account. No code, no password — sharing your number is the proof.

channel.none: No delivery method is available right now. Please try again later.
channel.sent: The code is on its way.

link.required: Open {{platform}} with the button below and share your number there. Then come back and send me the code.
link.waiting: I cannot see it yet. Finish in {{platform}}, then press the button again.

register.askPassword: Choose a password. It is deleted from this chat the moment it arrives.
register.passwordKept: I could not delete your message — please delete it yourself.
register.done: Your account is ready and you are signed in ✅

forgot.askPassword: Send your new password. It is deleted from this chat the moment it arrives.
forgot.done: Your password is changed and every other device has been signed out ✅

help.body:
I am your account, here in this chat: sign in, create an account, reset a password — without going anywhere else.

/menu — the main menu
/cancel — drop whatever we are in the middle of
/logout — sign out of this chat
/help — this message

While we are talking you can always go Back one question, or Cancel. Nothing is saved until the last step, and a password you type is deleted from the chat the moment it is used.

command.start: Start over at the main menu
command.cancel: Drop what we are in the middle of

language.only: This bot speaks one language at the moment.

accounts.pick: You are signed in as {{name}}. Tap another account to become it — no password, no code.
accounts.none:
You are signed in as {{name}}, and no other account is linked to it yet.
Add one below: that account proves itself once — a code to its own number, or its own password — and after that you can move between them here with one tap.
accounts.addPickProof: The account you are adding has to prove it is yours. How should it do that?
accounts.addAskPhone: Send the phone number of the account you are adding (09xxxxxxxxx). The code goes to that number, not to this chat.
accounts.addAskIdentifier: Send the username or phone number of the account you are adding.
accounts.addAskPassword: Send that account's password. It is deleted from this chat the moment it arrives.
accounts.added: ✅ The account is added. You are still signed in as before — open “My accounts” whenever you want to switch to it.
accounts.removePick: Which account should leave this set? It is removed here only — anything you set up on the website stays as it is.
accounts.removeConfirm:
Remove {{name}} from your accounts in this chat?
It will be signed out here, and you can add it back any time by proving it again.
accounts.removeConfirmSelf:
Remove {{name}} — the account you are using right now?
You will be signed out of this chat, and the others stay where they are.
accounts.removed: ✅ Removed from your accounts in this chat.
accounts.removedSelf: ✅ Removed, and you are signed out here. Tap Sign in whenever you want to come back.
accounts.removeFailed: That account is no longer one you can remove here.
